Tooltip: Retrieves the latest valid OTP from Microsoft Outlook 365 based on the configured mail account, subject, and extraction pattern. The activity retries the search until a valid OTP is found or the configured timeout is reached.

Arguments.Name: TenantID
Arguments.Tooltip: The Microsoft Entra Tenant ID for the Microsoft 365 application. Used together with the Client ID to authenticate and authorize access to Microsoft 365 resources.

Arguments.Name: ClientID
Arguments.Tooltip: Microsoft Entra Application (Client) ID required for Outlook 365 authentication. This value is obtained from the App Registration in Microsoft Entra ID and is used to establish a secure connection to Microsoft 365.

Arguments.Name: OrchestratorFolderPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Specifies the full orchestrator folder path where should access assets orchestrator resources for get the client secret used in microsoft outlook 365. Leave empty to used the current folder.

Arguments.Name: ClientSecretAssetName
Arguments.Tooltip: Specifies the name of the orchestrator credential asset used to retrieve authentication credential for microsoft 365. The asset must exist in the specified orchestrator folder.

Arguments.Name: ImpersonatedUserEmail
Arguments.Tooltip: Specifies the email address of the target Microsoft 365 mailbox that the application will access during execution. This value is used when application authentication is configured and mailbox impersonation is required.

Arguments.Name: MailFolder
Arguments.Tooltip: The Microsoft 365 mailbox folder to search for emails. If no folder is specified, the activity retrieves emails from default value 'Inbox'.

Arguments.Name: OtpMailSubject
Arguments.Tooltip: Subject text or keyword used to identify the expected OTP email. Supports full or partial subject matching.

Arguments.Name: OtpRegexPattern
Arguments.Tooltip: The regex pattern used to extract the OTP code from the email body.

Arguments.Name: OtpRequestDateTime
Arguments.Tooltip: Reference date and time used to validate the OTP email received timestamp. Only emails received within the configured validation criteria relative to this timestamp should be considered for OTP extraction.

Arguments.Name: EnableUIFallback
Arguments.Tooltip: Enables get OTP code with Outlook UI automation as a fallback when the Outlook 365 API method is fails.

Arguments.Name: OutlookAppPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Optional. Specifies the file system path to the Microsoft Outlook application executable used for UI automation when the UI fallback is enabled.

Arguments.Name: TopGetMail
Arguments.Tooltip: Retrieves the specified properties from the top N Microsoft 365 mail messages in a selected mailbox folder. The default N is 30.

Arguments.Name: TimeoutMicrosoft365
Arguments.Tooltip: The maximum time, in seconds, that the Microsoft 365 scope waits for an authentication before timing out. Increase this value if network latency or service response times are higher than expected. The default value is 120 seconds.

Arguments.Name: OtpCode
Arguments.Tooltip: Extracted OTP code from the matching email.
